tv: v6 is current (late 2024) and gets additions almost monthly: bid and ask, request.footprint, multiline strings, sorting of user-defined types, the once keyword.

tv: v5 scripts keep running; a v6 converter is built into the editor. v6 changed behavior, not just syntax.

tv: Per-line execution time profiling.
why: Helps heavy scripts. Not a switching reason.

tv: Language changes ship nearly every month.

tv: Nothing comparable.

tv: None. TradingView charges vendors $29.95 per user once they pass 100 users.

tv: Nothing comparable.
why: Bulk import of customer lists, invite links and onboarding emails. Switching friction is the biggest risk to the plan.

tv: TradingView holds invite-only source privately.

tv: None official.
why: Stripe, LaunchPass and Gumroad on the same access API, so vendors are not forced onto Whop.

tv: None. Vendors link accounts through third-party bots.
